mapper.select: SELECT TOP(#{days}) CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), access_time, 120) AS day, COUNT(*) AS total, SUM(CASE WHEN direction = 'IN' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS enter_count, SUM(CASE WHEN direction = 'OUT' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS exit_count, SUM(CASE WHEN access_status = 'DENIED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS denied_count FROM access_log WHERE access_time >= DATEADD(DAY, -#{days}, GETDATE()) GROUP BY CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), access_time, 120) ORDER BY day DESC
SELECT gate_location AS location, COUNT(*) AS total, SUM(CASE WHEN access_status = 'DENIED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS denied FROM access_log GROUP BY gate_location ORDER BY total DESC
